title: Jesus... I'm Scared To Watch My Mother Get Weaker?

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Jesus, I am scared to watch my mother get weaker?

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: I sat outside her room for ten minutes before I could go in.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Ten minutes is not failure. It is a daughter gathering herself.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: I should be stronger for her.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: You are already doing the strong thing. You went in.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: I do not know what to say to her.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Then do not say. Stay. Where she goes, you have decided to go. She knows.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: What if I am not enough for this?

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: You are not. That is not an insult. No one is enough for this alone.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: You bring your not enough into that room, and I will be in there too. I have never once left a bedside.

bible.text: But Ruth replied, “Don’t urge me to leave you or to turn back from you. Where you go I will go, and where you stay I will stay. Your people will be my people and your God my God.
